author: Vivian Nguyen
title: Tipton County safe space opens for social media sales - NewsBreak
text:
By Vivian Nguyen ,
5 hours ago MEMPHIS, Tenn. -- The Tipton County Sheriff's Office has announced a Safe Space/Exchange Zone at its station for people meeting to purchase or sell items.
Two reserved parking spaces are marked with red lines and have signs posted located in the sheriff's office parking lot at 1801 South College St. in Covington, Tenn., TCSO said.
Safe Space at Tipton County Sheriff's Office Two Memphis hospitals named among best in Tennessee "These dedicated parking spaces, as well as the whole parking lot, are under continuous video surveillance, including a camera dedicated solely to the Safe Zone. We want to provide a well-lit, highly visible location with recorded video to help promote a safer environment for everyone involved," said Sheriff Shannon Beasley of TCSO.
Beasley said deputies have heard how social media sales can turn into theft or crimes of violence, so the spaces will protect those trying to sell or purchase anything.
The monitored spaces are free to use at any time and also available for child custody exchanges.
